title: 第7章 韩老头的狗弟子第8章 狗师兄狗师妹来了
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
云隐镇在黑雾森林断魂崖边，距离摘星宗遗迹不远。
云星落按照剑灵教给的方法出了遗迹，一出来就在那棵大树下。
“吼！”
刚一出门，就听到一声惊天的吼叫声，惊得云星落一下哆嗦。
她抱紧了诛邪剑，“小剑剑，我现在还是凡人，等下有妖兽出没你可得帮着点。”
剑灵在剑身内无奈地捂着脸，“我的小祖宗，这里是云隐镇边缘，有阵法加持，不会有妖兽出没的。”
“哦。”
云星落终于松了一口气，又吩咐道，“等下进镇子的时候你变一下身，现在的你太酷炫太扎眼了，我怕保护不了你。”
“知道了，还真是胆小。”
剑灵不屑地撇撇嘴。
“你懂个屁，小心驶得万年船，赶紧给我变。”
“知道了，但请主人以后别叫我小剑剑，我有名字，我叫斩魂，专斩人魂。”
“你不是叫诛邪剑吗？”
“诛邪剑是剑的名字，斩魂是本剑灵的名字，懂吗？”
斩魂在剑身里翻了个白眼。
它没有再多纠缠，开始变身，又变成那副铁锈斑斑的样子。
云星落看了很满意，背着剑进入云隐小镇。
起初她以为这就是一个很小的镇子，进去一看才知道自己错了。
整个镇子横竖各有五条街，每条街道都有上千丈长。
镇中店铺林立，行人络绎不绝。

有凡人，也有修士。
修士清一色全是金丹以上，元婴修士也比比皆是，堪比一个大宗门。
不过修士虽多，但大多都是散修，谁也不理谁。
除了修士，还有很多凡人，他们和外面的凡人完全不一样。
在外间，凡人是很卑微的，见到修炼之人都是恭恭敬敬的，而这里的凡人，一个个昂首挺胸的，很是自信。
云星落没有心情关注这些，她直奔包子铺，一口气买了一百个大肉包，一百个馒头。
直到连吃下三个肉包，她才感觉自己活了过来。
一回头，却看见三名身着怪异的青年修士在看着她。
这三人一个身穿紫衣，一个绿衣，一个红衣，像三只大公鸡，一个个都在憋着笑。
穿着紫衣的修士实在憋不住了开口道，“真是好笑，这年月还有这样的饿死鬼，一口气吃那么多，还净是垃圾玩意。”
云星落嘴里还咬着一个大肉包，她没有开口，心道煞笔吧，她现在是凡人，吃这些怎么了？
她不想理会这些煞笔，只想赶紧把东西买完回去。
这时，三个当中的绿衣感觉到了不对劲，他皱了皱眉，“不对，这女娃身上怎么有那老头的气息？”
紫衣特地靠近了云星落，用鼻子像狗一样嗅了嗅，“没错，确实有那老头的气息。”
说罢，他面色一沉，冷声道，“喂，小鬼，有没有见过一名身穿麻衣，脚穿布鞋，爱抠鼻子，邋里邋遢的老头？”
云星落听着紫衣青年的描述，他说的怎么那么像韩老头？
莫非这三人就是韩老头的狗弟子？
正愣着，紫衣青年又喝斥道，“小鬼，我说话你听见没有，有没有见过这样的老头？”
“你们爹妈没教过你们问人的基本礼貌吗？真没素质，没见过！”
云星落没好气回了一句，转身就走。

她刚转身，紫衣青年拦住了她的去路，“小鬼，我们说话你听不懂是吗？直说了吧，你身上有我们要找的人的气息，如果你知道他在哪，赶紧告诉我们，不然我们把你扔到森林去喂妖兽。”
威胁，赤裸裸的威胁。
她虽然胆小，更是怕死，但也不喜欢被人威胁。
她开启异瞳，只见三人身上漂浮着一道熟悉的气息，正是韩老头的气息。
“果然是他的狗弟子！”
content_en:
Yunyin Town is located on the edge of the Broken Soul Cliff in the Black Mist Forest, not far from the ruins of the Star Reaching Sect.
Yun Xingluo came out of the ruins according to the method taught by Sword Spirit, and as soon as he came out, he was under the big tree.
"Roar!"
As soon as he went out, he heard a shocking roar, which made Yun Xingluo tremble.
She hugged the Evil Zhuing Sword tightly, "Xiao Jianjian, I'm still a mortal now. You have to help me when there are monsters coming out later."
The sword spirit covered his face helplessly within the sword, "My little ancestor, this is the edge of Yunyin Town. With the blessing of the formation, there will be no monsters."
"Oh."
Yun Xingluo finally breathed a sigh of relief and ordered, "When you enter the town, change your appearance. You are too cool and eye-catching now. I'm afraid I can't protect you."
"I know, you are really cowardly."
The sword spirit curled his lips in disdain.
"You know nothing. Be careful about sailing the ten-thousand-year-old ship. Please change it quickly."
"I understand, but master, please don't call me Xiao Jianjian in the future. I have a name. My name is Zhanhun, and I specialize in killing human souls."
"Isn't your name the Evil Killing Sword?"
"The Execution Sword is the name of the sword, and the Soul Killing Sword is the name of the sword spirit. Do you understand?"
Zhanhun rolled his eyes in the sword.
It didn't linger any longer and began to transform, turning into its rusty appearance again.
Yun Xingluo was very satisfied with what he saw, and entered Yunyin Town with his sword on his back.
At first she thought it was just a small town, but when she went in and took a look, she realized she was wrong.
The entire town has five streets horizontally and vertically, each of which is thousands of feet long.
There are many shops in the town and there is an endless stream of pedestrians.
There are mortals and monks.
The monks are all golden elixir or higher, and Nascent Soul monks are everywhere, comparable to a large sect.
However, although there are many monks, most of them are casual cultivators and pay no attention to anyone.
In addition to monks, there are many mortals who are completely different from the mortals outside.
In the outside world, mortals are very humble and are respectful to cultivators when they see them. However, the mortals here hold their heads high and are very confident.
Yun Xingluo was not in the mood to pay attention to this. She went straight to the bun shop and bought a hundred large meat buns and a hundred steamed buns in one go.
It wasn't until she ate three meat buns that she felt alive.
When she turned around, she saw three young monks in strange clothes looking at her.
One of these three people was dressed in purple, one in green, and one in red. They looked like three big roosters, and all of them were holding back laughter.
The monk in purple clothes couldn't hold it in anymore and said, "It's really funny. There are still such starving people in these days. They eat so much in one go and they are just rubbish."
Yun Xingluo still had a big meat bun in her mouth, but she didn't speak. She must have been thinking, she is a mortal now, what's wrong with eating this?
She didn't want to pay attention to these bad words, she just wanted to finish shopping and go back quickly.
At this time, the green one among the three felt something was wrong. He frowned and said, "No, why does this girl have the aura of the old man on her body?"
Ziyi specially approached Yun Xingluo and sniffed it like a dog, "Yes, there is indeed that old man's scent."
After that, his face darkened and he said in a cold voice, "Hey, kid, have you ever seen a sloppy old man wearing linen clothes and cloth shoes who loves to pick his nose?"
Yun Xingluo listened to the description of the young man in purple. Why did he sound so like Old Man Han?
Could it be that these three people are Old Man Han’s dog disciples?
While he was stunned, the young man in purple shouted again, "Kid, did you hear what I said? Have you ever seen such an old man?"
"Didn't your parents teach you the basic courtesy of asking people? You're so unqualified, I've never seen it before!"
Yun Xingluo replied angrily, turned around and left.
As soon as she turned around, the young man in purple blocked her way, "Kid, you can't understand what we are saying, can you? Just tell the truth, you have the aura of the person we are looking for. If you know where he is, tell us quickly, or we will throw you into the forest to feed the monsters."
threatening, nakedthreats.
Although she is timid and even afraid of death, she doesn't like to be threatened.
She opened her special eyes and saw a familiar aura floating around the three of them, which was none other than Old Man Han's aura.
"He is indeed his dog disciple!"
